column1: # stable-controls targets (TASKS T-006, T-017 PR-3), tab separated.
# expect: stays (nothing may move) or moves (detector self-test: the target must report a move).
# spike: the temp chips and the mode toggle shift when selected; spike-bottom: the unusual-rate warning under
# the stepper goes away at 1.00 hr/lb, the content shrinks and the view clamps (Jason's T-004 review).
# start: top (as opened) or bottom (scrolled to the end first: content shrinking below a control makes the view clamp and jump).
# Plan (T-017 PR-3): flipping Ready by / Start at re-times the plan; the toggle and everything above it stay.
# plan-bottom starts scrolled to the tiles: nothing may shrink and make the view clamp.
# Food details (T-019): the 0.2.0 bug was the screen scrolling to the result after every weight tap. Every
# stepper and chip stays put, opened at the top and scrolled to the end (food-bottom: a control not on screen
# there is scrolled up to, so it is as low as it can be with the list as far down as it goes).
# Hours per pound is only in food-bottom: opened at the top it sits behind the pinned result bar, where a tap
# lands on the bar (the first run did that: the bar scrolled to the result card, as it should).
